correctness.rationale: Over characteristic three the Walsh basis is invertible and diagonalizes A_d with residues 0,+1,-1 having b_d,a_d,a_d multiplicities from the exact coordinate-extension recurrence. On their two-row sectors M_0^2=-I, M_+ has one size-two Jordan block at -1, and M_- has one at +1; their fixed nullities yield all six q-exponents and T^12=I. Möbius subtraction gives P12=q^(2a)(q^(2a)-1)(q^(2b)-1), exact primitive counts, and orders 4/6/12 in d=0/1/>=2. Independent GF(3) matrix ranks for d=0..3 reproduced fixed populations (d=2: 3,9,9,729,81,6561). The algebra, not low-d enumeration, supports all d and F_{3^f}; the Q0 isolated-vertex convention and independence of two initial levels were checked.
